title: Last Minute Notes -LMNs - GeeksforGeeks
content:
The GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) exam is one of the most prestigious and widely recognized exams for admission to postgraduate programs (M.Tech, M.S.) in various engineering disciplines across India. Not only for advanced studies, it is also a gateway to career opportunities in the public and private sectors. GATE is conducted jointly by the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and Indian Institute of Science (IISc).

For Computer Science (CS) and Data Analytics (DA), the GATE exam tests a candidate's understanding and proficiency in subjects like Mathematics, Data Structures, Algorithms, Programming, Computer Networks, Operating Systems and more.

For those preparing for the GATE CS and DA exams, we’ll cover here key concepts and important topics to help you navigate through the final stages of preparation and ensure you are well-prepared for the exam.

Last Minute Notes (LMNs) for GATE CS & IT

Prepare for GATE CS with concise last-minute notes for the key subjects listed below:

  • C Programming
  • Data Structures
  • Algorithms
  • Theory of Computation
  • Compiler Design
  • Digital Electronics
  • Computer Organization
  • Operating Systems
  • DBMS
  • Computer Networks
  • Engineering Mathematics
  • Discrete Mathematics

Last Minute Notes (LMNs) for GATE DA

Get ready for GATE DA with these essential revision notes for the topics that matter most:

  • Probability and Statistics
  • Linear Algebra
  • Calculus and Optimization
  • Python Programming
  • Data Structures in Python
  • Algorithms
  • DBMS
  • Data Warehousing
  • Machine Learning
  • Artificial Intelligence
